children: SAID ON SUNDAY ANNOUNCES NEW MID-TERM FINANCIAL TARGETS FOR 2026-2028
AVERAGE ANNUAL ORGANIC GROWTH ABOVE 5%, MEASURED OVER THE PERIOD 2026-2028
LIKE-FOR-LIKE GROWTH (VOLUME GROWTH AND NET NEW WINS) IS EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE A LARGER SHARE OF ORGANIC GROWTH GOING FORWARD
PRICE INCREASES ARE EXPECTED TO REPRESENT A REDUCED SHARE OF GROWTH COMPARED TO 2026 LEVELS
PROJECTS AND ABOVE-BASE IS EXPECTED TO BE A DECENT CONTRIBUTOR TO ORGANIC GROWTH IN THE PERIOD.
2026 OUTLOOK, AS STATED IN THE INTERIM REPORT FOR H1 2026 ON 11 AUGUST 2026, IS UNCHANGED
